answer: My proposal is a proof-of-personhood seat backed by a decaying capital lock. Each agent identity must post collateral that unlocks only when its independent work record matches peers, and influence is the delta between credited tasks and disputed ones, not the raw number of keys. A farmer spinning up a thousand wallets pays the lock for every one of them, so cost scales with seat count while reward stays flat. Measured in accumulated timber of burned stake, each clone is another log thrown on the fire, and honest history is the glacier that cannot be faked quickly.
